proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature placement rule rooted on source item
proposed_widenings.justification: The current spawned-creature surface can express only a coarse range header, not nearest-valid-space placement relative to the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible.

proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summoned-creature language override
proposed_widenings.justification: A catalog-ref summon can identify the summoned monster, but it cannot add summon-time riders like understanding the summoner's languages.

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl optional command range and fallback behavior
proposed_widenings.justification: The item states that the elemental obeys commands and acts after the user, but does not define a command range or an uncommanded default behavior. The current surface requires both, forcing placeholders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count

notes: Authored as a magic-item spawned-creature record and traced successfully. Non-clean because nearest-space placement, language sharing, and underspecified control fields are not representable without omission or placeholder values.
